name: Cryptocurrency Exchanges
author: pressreleasereviews

sections.description:
Displays a list cryptocurrency exchanges in your sidebar or any widget area of your website. You can use it any sidebar or any menu area that allows you to use widgets.

Please visit pressreleasereviews.com to learn more about the plugin or for plugin support.

Credits
sections.installation:
1. Unzip and Upload cryptocurrency-exchanges.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory inside of a folder named “/cryptocurrency-exchanges”

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

  3. Then go to the Widgets section of your wordpress site and simply drag and drop the widget titled “Cryptocurrency Exchanges” to any widget area of your website. You can also activate the widget through any wordpress menu on your site.
sections.faq:

This plugin requires minimum version 4.6 or later of WordPress.

Does this plugin have any issues with any other plugins or themes?

This plugin is safe and fully tested with all current version of WordPress. Works fine with all other plugins, works perfectly with yoast wordpress seo plugin, contact form 7, akismet, also jetpack, and also works perfectly with any theme, no compatibility issues with any plugins or any other themes. This plugin is tested and safe for your wp site or blog and fully responsive and tested in all browsers.
